steps.content: The WhiteSands channel, typically ravaged by violent sandstorms, is unusually tranquil today. A mild breeze ruffles small cacti, as fine grains of sand cascade endlessly over the dunes. Even the sun overhead appears less blistering.
After an extensive journey, the Nirvana sand ship caravan is nearly at their rest stop. Despite the favorable weather, the entire crew finds themselves unconsciously picking up their pace.

Along the channel where the sand ships pass, a subtle vibration swiftly approaches from behind, rippling through the sand. The monitoring equipment promptly identifies the anomaly and sounds an alarm.

The buzzing noise grows louder as the vibration intensifies. Without a moment to spare, the sturdy mechanical hull abruptly detonates, hurling metal shards and sand in every direction. In an instant, the entire caravan is engulfed by the blast.
